notes.title: Update notes for November 20th version
notes.content:
- Added another map
- Elemental bullets and lasers now share a Synergy Level together, so the player needs to combine the correct laser and bullet types, in order to unlock that bullet's Synergy Stats
- Added a visual indicator for the level of all equipped items
